facts.business: India Homes Limited is a Mumbai-focused real estate redevelopment company that transitioned from stainless steel manufacturing to urban redevelopment projects in Wadala, Matunga, Chembur, and Khopoli through joint ventures and direct development.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Multiple phases, monetisation expected from FY2026-27

capacity_or_capex.item: Redevelopment pipeline (India Court Wadala, King Court Matunga, Duke Court Chembur)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Project monetisation from redevelopment pipeline to begin

auditor.name: Laxmikant Kabra & Co LLP (Corporate Governance) / CGCA & Associates LLP (Statutory Auditors proposed)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Disclaimer of opinion on financial statements; primary accounting software (SAP) and records not accessible; books prepared using alternative software from opening balances and backup records; unable to obtain sufficient audit evidence on completeness, accuracy, authenticity, and integrity of books; material uncertainty on going concern due to current liabilities exceeding current assets, ceased operations, significant losses, and severe financial constraints; delayed regulatory submissions (shareholding pattern, reconciliation of share capital audit, board meeting intimation)

key_risks: Legacy financial matters and debt settlements
